findings.title: Reject deep paths before quadratic ancestry-prefix expansion
findings.trigger: A local absolute path with8192 one-character components,16386 chars within the admitted32768-character path limit; trusted-provider DATA snapshot has zero ancestors and must be refused.
findings.actual: Both modules materialize every ancestor prefix via parts.map/slice/path.join before checking the ancestry length. Separate finite workers with64MiB old heap reach ERR_WORKER_OUT_OF_MEMORY instead of CWD_REFUSED/PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE. Small three-component controls return correct finite refusals.
findings.expected: Refuse unsupported depth/incomplete ancestry with bounded metadata allocation, before constructing all prefixes. Existing128-entry ancestry limit should bound actual work.
findings.impact: Pure authority availability/resource failure. If later executed on native main, this synchronous expansion could consume substantial memory/time before refusal. No actual native-main crash or current renderer exploit is claimed; these modules are not integrated or execution-admitted.
